change.summary: Added a generated asymmetric four-corner SOLID selector. It asserts ext=false preserves all raw OCS tuples, thickness, and extrusion, and ext=true transforms all four tuples exactly once for normal (0,1,0). Registered the selector as the focused libdxfrw_solid_nondefault_ocs CTest. No production code or persistent fixture changed.
